result.reason: The redline does not reach either playbook position. It raises only IBM’s cap to the preferred threshold, while Customer’s separate cap remains the greater of USD 100,000 or fees paid, so the cap is not mutual. The carve-out inserted into the IBM-specific limitation does not clearly apply to Customer’s cap, omits infringement of the other party’s IP, and leaves intact the exclusion for loss of or damage to data, which may defeat meaningful recovery for data/security breaches. The mutual consequential-damages exclusion and payment-obligation treatment remain, but the phrase “a party’s” within an IBM-only liability provision is structurally ambiguous. The edits are targeted and otherwise preserve the existing commercial language, but the operative drafting is incomplete despite the margin comment identifying one of the unresolved issues.
